operation.name: InsertOrUpdates
operation.sql: INSERT INTO auth_users (auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, date_active) VALUES (:auth_key_id, :user_id, :hash, :date_created, :date_active) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hash = VALUES(hash), date_active = VALUES(date_active), deleted = 0

operation.name: Select
operation.sql: SELECT id, auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, date_active, android_push_session_id FROM auth_users WHERE auth_key_id = :auth_key_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: UpdateAndroidPushSessionId
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET android_push_session_id = :android_push_session_id WHERE auth_key_id = :auth_key_id AND user_id = :user_id

operation.name: SelectAuthKeyIds
operation.sql: SELECT id, auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, date_active, android_push_session_id FROM auth_users WHERE user_id = :user_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: DeleteByHashList
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET deleted = 1, date_created = 0, date_active = 0 WHERE id IN (:idList)

operation.name: SelectListByUserId
operation.sql: SELECT id, auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, date_active, android_push_session_id FROM auth_users WHERE user_id = :user_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: Delete
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET deleted = 1, date_active = 0 WHERE auth_key_id = :auth_key_id AND user_id = :user_id

operation.name: DeleteUser
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET deleted = 1, date_active = 0 WHERE user_id = :user_id

operation.name: SelectAuthorizationSettingsByUserId
operation.sql: SELECT id, auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, encrypted_requests_disabled, call_requests_disabled, unconfirmed FROM auth_users WHERE user_id = :user_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: SelectAuthorizationSettingsByAuthKeyId
operation.sql: SELECT id, auth_key_id, user_id, hash, date_created, encrypted_requests_disabled, call_requests_disabled, unconfirmed FROM auth_users WHERE auth_key_id = :auth_key_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: UpdateAuthorizationSettings
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET encrypted_requests_disabled = :encrypted_requests_disabled, call_requests_disabled = :call_requests_disabled, unconfirmed = :unconfirmed WHERE id = :id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: UpdateUnconfirmed
operation.sql: UPDATE auth_users SET unconfirmed = 1 WHERE auth_key_id = :auth_key_id AND user_id = :user_id AND deleted = 0

operation.name: CountLiveByUserId
operation.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM auth_users WHERE user_id = :user_id AND deleted = 0
